name: array-demo
description: T13 array-artifact test. Input: {"count": N}. split-range emits ARRAY_INLINE of N i32 values [0..N-1]; fan-process stores each i² as a separate store entry and emits ARRAY_BY_HASH; reduce-sum opens each element and sums. Subscribe: square-sum (= Σ i² for i in [0..N-1]).
